about: SiteForge section library. A site = one preset + src/sections.json, an ordered list of {slot, variant, tone?}. All copy lives in src/content.json.

presets.heritage: warm, established family firms; serif headings; limestone ground
presets.clean-local: light, friendly; domestic trades, gardeners, cafés
presets.bold: high contrast, big type; younger or punchy businesses

tones: Each variant has a default tone (base | surface | band = dark/brand | accent = brand fill); override per entry with "tone". Alternate tones down the page.
rules: Order: nav, hero, trust, services, then any of about/process/reviews/gallery in the order that suits, service-area, cta, contact, footer.
One variant per slot; nav, hero, contact and footer are required; reviews and gallery render nothing without real data, so include them only when data exists.
Never put two sections with tone band next to each other (e.g. area-towns tone band then cta-band); alternate base and surface.
Use hero-review-led or trust-rating when there are real reviews and a rating.
End the page with one phone moment only: footer-big-phone never with cta-band or contact-details; pair it with a form contact and cta-split/cta-callout.
The hero headline must name the trade (or what they do) and the home town.
Never pair cta-split or cta-band with contact-details (contact routes twice in a row); use cta-callout.
Photos decide the hero: with a hero photo use hero-split-image or hero-full-bleed; with none use hero-typographic (or hero-review-led when reviews exist). SiteForge enforces this.
A second photo goes in About: use about-split or about-owner-note, never about-facts, when about.image exists.
The rating shows at most twice: once in the hero (badge OR review card) and once in reviews. Trust items never mention the rating; use area, hours or contact facts.
Every section's content starts on the same left edge as the nav logo; no centred or offset columns.
Variants marked labs are only offered when SITEFORGE_LABS=1; SiteForge swaps them for a stable variant otherwise.

variants.desc: Sticky bar: name left, links + call button right.
Name centred like a shopfront fascia, double rule, links row beneath, phone right.
Dark utility strip (what we do + phone) above a sticky main bar.
Headline left, the business's own photo right (best landscape Places photo, credited).
Their photo across the full width, words low on a scrim, photo credit in the corner.
No photo: huge headline + van-door contact panel, the trade's icon as an oversized faint brand-colour outline behind.
Headline + 3-photo mosaic; fewer photos degrade to one photo or phone panel.
Headline beside one real review as a card (<=25 words, chosen at build). The card is the hero's only rating moment.
3-4 short promises in a ruled row under the hero, type only.
Heading beside spec-sheet rows of reasons (title + one line).
Google rating big with promises beside. Use when there's a rating but no review texts.
Two-column ruled list: service name + one line. No icons. Good for 3-10 services.
Sticky heading left, ruled list of services right. Good for long lists.
Main service featured large (points or photo), the rest as spec-sheet rows.
One service at a time: names as tabs, detail + points beside.
Photo + story (used whenever a second photo exists); no photo: heading left, story right.
A signed letter from the owner. Best with a real first name.
Story left, ruled facts list (base, hours, cover) right.
Numbered steps across one rule (3-5 steps).
Vertical timeline with numbered markers, heading left.
Steps as tinted panels with big numerals, heading on the page's left edge.
One review quoted large, next few beside. Hidden without real reviews.
All reviews in balanced columns. Hidden without real reviews.
Swipeable row of review panels. Hidden without real reviews. Best 3+.
Even grid of real job photos with captions. Hidden with <3 photos.
One large photo leading smaller ones. Hidden with <3 photos.
SIGNATURE: towns set as large type like a van door; home town pinned.
Map centred on home town + town list. Needs business.lat/lng.
Full-width dark band: ask left, phone huge right.
Ask one side, every contact route listed the other.
Contained brand-colour panel with the ask + buttons.
Details list left, quote form right.
No form: phone at full size, WhatsApp, email, hours, Maps link.
One focused form column on the page's left edge, call/WhatsApp beside it.
One quiet row: name, links, phone, legal.
Dark footer: who, contact, towns, links.
The number at poster size as the page's last word.
LABS. Their photo full-bleed under hairline grid columns; poster headline low, top services on a rule beneath, phone card in the bottom-right cell. Band tone grid without a photo.
LABS. The brand colour drenches the hero with a one-hue tonal depth; headline mid-left with + marks, services as a ruled label row near the bottom. No photo needed.
LABS. The hero is the start of the quote: 'What needs doing?' box with service chips that prefills the contact form; big phone beside it. Needs a contact variant with a form.
LABS. Services as one bordered table of shared hairlines; each cell (icon, name, one line) starts a quote for that service.
LABS. One slow loop of the town names at headline size on the brand colour; pauses on hover, static under reduced motion. Needs 3+ towns.
LABS. Phone, email and links on a rule, then the business name at poster size cropped by the page's bottom edge.
LABS. Dark closing step: details left, quote form right that opens with tappable service chips instead of a dropdown.
